summary: Closure review: the authors addressed the three prior required revisions. The manuscript now contains a conventional numbered References list with full bibliographic metadata (aligned to archived records), an explicit archival pointer to per-call runtime sampling records in Methods (execution/provider_calls/ and execution/raw_results.jsonl) with the temperature=null clarification, and a citation-verification statement confirming each numbered citation supports the adjacent claim. The preregistered harmful-overrepair aggregation remains uncomputed in the archived confirmatory summary but is transparently disclosed and reproducible from archived artifacts. No unresolved critical issues remain; the paper meets the prior closure conditions.
optional_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement to improve readability while preserving the mandatory master-prompt locator and its SHA-256 digest.
Optionally move machine-internal artifact paths and long per-file hashes out of the main prose into a short appendix or the archived artifact manifest reference to improve readability.
